body.methodNote: Derived: a district's monthly mean flow (runoff depth × real area) above its own Q10 (flow exceeded 10 % of months) is high, below its own Q90 is low, otherwise normal; thresholds from the district's complete months of the full years since 2000. Modelled flow per district, not gauged stations.
